body:
Real Terraform module (deploy/terraform/) targeting the existing prrject-fatbaby GKE Autopilot cluster via a data source only (never creates/touches the cluster itself, per founder instruction); real Dockerfile+nginx config (deploy/docker/) serving the client as static files; real GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/deploy-wasm.yml). terraform init/validate clean. Found and documented a real, current risk: the cluster's own 2026-09-04 audit found 0 schedulable nodes for 32+ hours, unresolved -- not re-verified this pass, no live gcloud creds in this sandbox. Full account: docs/WASM_DEPLOY_NORTHSTAR.md.

⚓ ☃
title: GitOps deploy pipeline (GH Actions + Terraform) scoped for the web client on GKE
